title: WorkspaceInvitation
description: Definition of an invitation for a member or admin to join the workspace.

id.description: Unique identifier of the invitation record.

role.description: Role to assign to the user upon accepting the invitation.

permissions.description: Initial dataset permissions matrix for the invitee.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when this invitation expires.

accepted_at.description: ISO timestamp when this invitation was accepted.

revoked.description: True if the invitation has been cancelled by an admin or owner.
